model_inference: none; actual Pi RPC host handles AutoTalk commands using isolated settings

assertions.expected: Actual Pi handles /autotalk:on and emits AutoTalk's enabled status

cases.name: happy_path

assertions.expected: Settings entered through Pi RPC persist and the enabled command reports the configured interval and mode

cases.name: error_path

assertions.expected: An invalid AutoTalk interval is rejected by the extension with a warning and is not persisted, without an unhandled host error
assertions.observed: {"response":{"id":"error-settings","type":"response","command":"prompt","success":true,"data":{"disposition":"handled"}},"warning":{"type":"extension_ui_request","id":"bf44f79a-9ad4-4bc8-9f10-474e530effd1","method":"notify","message":"Interval must be an integer from 5 to 120 seconds.","notifyType":"warning"},"expectedBefore":{"intervalSec":15,"deliveryMode":"steer"},"seedValid":true,"persistedBefore":{"intervalSec":15,"deliveryMode":"steer"},"persistedAfter":{"intervalSec":15,"deliveryMode":"steer"},"unhandledError":false}

assertions.expected: Supplemental: malformed RPC frames are still rejected by the Pi host parser with success=false, and the parser host exits cleanly
assertions.observed: {"parse":{"type":"response","command":"parse","success":false,"error":"Failed to parse command: Unexpected token 'o', \"not-json\" is not valid JSON"},"parserHostExit":{"code":0,"exitObserved":true,"timedOut":false,"spawnError":null}}

cases.name: reload_cleanup

assertions.expected: A second actual Pi host loads the persisted AutoTalk settings and handles /autotalk:on
The reloaded host emits the feature status using settings persisted by the first host
Both actual Pi hosts close with exit code zero and no unhandled or shutdown errors
Native host shell launches the locally pinned Pi CLI and returns its exact SDK version
